3.2
Proving Worst-Case Hardness
We present a proof for Theorem 3.7. The proof for Theorem 3.8 is completely analogous and follows
by replacing the point of reference from lattices in I(O) to their dual (see Section 3.2.3). Our proofs
are related to ones in previous works and in particular to the one in [PRSD17], see Section 3.2.4
for details.
